input.question: Who is the artist of the song "Shy Boy"?

documents.text: Shy Boy (Secret song) "Shy Boy" (Korean: 샤이보이) is a single by South Korean girl group Secret. It is released as a CD single on January 6, 2011 through TS Entertainment. The song was written and produced by Kang Jiwon and Kim Kibum. It was remade with Japanese lyrics and was on Secret's first Japanese EP, "Shy Boy". According to Gaon, "Shy Boy" has sold over 2,215,864 digital downloads in South Korea as of December 31, 2011. Secret released the teaser for their single "Shy Boy" on January 2, 2011. The single was released on music stores and digital music
